description: This file defines the 'Apcu' class within the Opencart system library cache namespace. It provides methods for interacting with the APCu cache extension, including get, set, delete, and flush functionalities, and handles cache expiration settings.

classes.name: Apcu
classes.description: A class that manages cache operations using APCu extension, including fetching, storing, deleting, and flushing cache entries with configurable expiration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache class, setting expiration and checking for APCu availability.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cache value associated with the provided key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in the cache with an optional expiration time.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the cache entry associated with the given key.
